title: Verification record identity
responsibility: Records tested component versions, attributes benchmark measurements, references earlier scenarios and seals complete verification records.

inputs.name: recordComponents.impact
inputs.description: Impact report identifying direct, indirect, added and removed units.

inputs.name: recordComponents.sides
inputs.description: Base and head manifests and owned source hashes used to identify the tested version, using base for removed units.

inputs.name: recordComponents.measured
inputs.description: Additional measured unit ids to include even when not reached by impact.

inputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements.gathered
inputs.description: Gathered captures whose parsed benchmark payloads may supply measurements.

inputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements.context
inputs.description: Current machine profile id and verified commit to attach to benchmark measurements.

inputs.name: referencedScenario.prior
inputs.description: Earlier verification record from which unaffected scenario evidence may be referenced.

inputs.name: referencedScenario.id
inputs.description: Scenario id to find in the prior record.

inputs.name: sealRecord.draft
inputs.description: Verification record fields except id, to hash canonically.

inputs.name: recordIntact.record
inputs.description: Record whose stored id should be compared with its current contents.

outputs.name: recordComponents
outputs.description: Sorted unique tested/measured components with source, manifest, contract and runtime hashes, files, target and change classification. Missing manifests are omitted.

outputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements
outputs.description: Measurements from valid benchmark payloads, attributed to the supplied profile/commit with empty artifacts; invalid payloads contribute nothing.

outputs.name: referencedScenario
outputs.description: Earlier nonfailed scenario marked referenced with its original referencedRecord retained, or the prior record id; undefined for missing/failed scenarios.

outputs.name: sealRecord
outputs.description: Record with id set to the SHA-256 of canonical draft JSON; no storage write occurs.

outputs.name: recordIntact
outputs.description: True when recomputing the canonical record hash matches its id.
